questions.question: How did Job describe his present condition compared to before?
options: Better off now than he had ever been in his life
Quite unchanged from the days of his former great wealth
Honored above all of the men of the whole east
Mocked by those younger than him and in deep affliction
questions.answer: Mocked by those younger than him and in deep affliction

questions.question: What did Job say happened when he cried to God?
options: God rebuked him from the storm

questions.question: Job said his harp was turned to mourning and his pipe to the voice of weeping.
Job said he was a brother of jackals and a companion of _____.
